<!-- Generated by scripts/dsl-reference.mjs from schema/, test/fixtures/public-surface.json and site/reference-notes/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Everything a visitor can open: lists, dashboards, forms and the rest, keyed by address. **Preview** keys work and may change in any release ([status](/docs/status/)); the rest are stable. [All parts](/docs/app-dsl/).

```ts
views: {
  triage: listView('Triage', 'issue', {
    query: 'status = backlog or status = ready',
    show: ['name', 'status', 'priority', 'assignee_id.name'],
    presentation: queue('name', { lines: ['status', 'priority'] }),
    filters: ['priority', 'assignee_id'],
  }),
  pipeline: listView('Pipeline', 'opportunity', { board: { by: 'stage', primary: 'name' } }),
},
```

The key is the view's address: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Every
dashboard and signed-in form must be reachable from `nav`, `home` or an embed,
or it is refused as an orphan. A list's `query` holds conditions only; its
order is `sort`, and a tab takes a `sort` of its own. Query strings are typed
where the App's schema is registered ([the limit](/docs/app-dsl/#typed-query-strings)).
`filters` and `totals` may name a rollup or computed column as they name a
column: `filters: ['state', 'spent']` offers a customer's lifetime spend as a
Min and a Max.

| `kind` | Helper | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `listView(label, table, opts)` or `listView(table, opts)` | The rows of one resource. [Lists](/docs/lists/) |
| `dashboard` | `dashboard(label, sections, opts)` | Sections about whole tables. [Dashboards](/docs/dashboards/) |
| `landing` | `landing(hero, sections, opts)` | The signed-out front page. [Public pages](/docs/landing-pages/) |
| `form` | `commandForm(label, command, steps, opts)` | One form over one command. [Command forms](/docs/command-forms/) |
| `room` | `room(label, component, { reads, params })` | A whole view drawn by a [custom component](/docs/custom-components/). |

## How a list's rows draw

A view says at most one of `presentation`, `board` and `split`; with none, the
rows are a grid.

| Spelling | Draws |
| --- | --- |
| `checklist(primary, checked, { lines? })` | A card per row with a checkbox. |
| `queue(primary, { lines?, facts?, badge?, openLabel? })` | A keyboard-first selection list; bulk actions apply to the selection. |
| `board: { by, lanes?, order?, swimlanes?, limits?, primary, lines?, sum?, folded? }` | Lanes by one column; cards move by drag, Alt+arrows or ⋯. `limits` are shown, never enforced. A lane's head adds up `sum` (else the card's money) — "Discovery · 3 · $92.8K" — and `folded: ['won', 'lost']` draws closed stages as strips a reader opens. A reference as `primary`, a line or a footer fact says the record it names: `primary: 'sales_order_id'`. |
| `split: { detail?, limit? }` | The list beside the picked record, addressed `/inbox/2`. |
| `calendar(date, primary, { end?, lines?, badge? })` | A month grid; with `end`, a bar across the days. |
| `cards(primary, { value?, badge?, icon?, description?, lines?, facts?, image?, media? })` | A grid of cards; a page's related list takes the same. |
| `customList(component, { show })` | Rows drawn by a custom component. |

## Dashboard sections

| Helper | Says |
| --- | --- |
| `metric(title, table, { measure?, query?, compare?, target?, to? })` | One figure; `compare: 'previous period'` adds a change. |
| `chart(title, table, by, { shape?, measure? })` | `line` (default), `bar`, `donut`, `stacked`. |
| `breakdown(title, table, by, { measure?, limit? })` | Groups as bars, a vocabulary's in its order. |
| `matrix(title, table, 'stage, month close_date', opts)` | Two keys as rows and columns. |
| `rows(title, table, { show, sort?, limit? })` | Matching rows. |
| `board(title, table, by, { lanes?, primary?, lines? })` | Lanes, full width. |
| `note(text, opts)`, `firstRun(title, steps)`, `activity(title, resources)` | Guidance, a welcome until the tables have rows, recent changes. |
| `embed(view, { tab?, limit?, interactive? })` | A list view inside the dashboard. |

Every table section also takes `query`, `over` (the date column the window
narrows), `windows`, `icon`, `title` and `width` (`full`, `two-thirds`,
`half`, `third`; with a dashboard's `areas`, an `area` instead). A measure is `count`, `sum amount`, `avg`, `min`, `max`,
`median` (PostgreSQL) or arithmetic over them (`sum won / sum amount as rate`).

## `views`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views` | object | Stable | Everything a visitor can open, keyed: the key is the view’s address. Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |

## `views.*[kind=dashboard].areas`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].areas` | array | Stable | The sections placed on a grid: one string per row, the same count of 1 to 4 space-separated cells in each, a cell an area name or . for none. A section names its area; an area that covers two rows spans them, several sections in one area stack, and a narrow screen stacks the areas in reading order. Every section names an area, and areas are not written with an aside. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/dashboards.ts`. |

## `views.*[kind=dashboard].aside`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].aside` | array | Stable | Sections in an independent context column beside the dashboard's main flow, drawn as a record page's aside: a landmark of its own, its lists drawn as names, the main flow's rows by width beside it and neither column's height waiting on the other's. A section whose height lines up with the ones beside it is placed with areas instead; a dashboard says one or the other. |

## `views.*[kind=dashboard].aside[]`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].aside[]` | | Stable | The same keys as `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[]`. |

| `views.*[kind=dashboard].description` | string | Stable | Short plain text shown beneath the dashboard heading. It may greet {me.name}; with no name it is left out. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |

| `views.*[kind=dashboard].favorite` | boolean | Stable | Opt-in: a star on the view, so a reader can keep it in Favorites. |

## `views.*[kind=dashboard].filters`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].filters` | array | Stable | Pick-filters: column names offered as selectors in the control row. A pick narrows every section whose table has the column; a vocabulary column offers its values, a whole single-column reference offers the records it points at, by name. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/views.ts`. |

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].from` | string | Stable | Default resource for sections that name none; a section's own from wins. Refused when every section names its own. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |

## `views.*[kind=dashboard].heading`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].heading` | string | Stable | false draws the dashboard without its title (it stays for a screen reader). Otherwise the words over the sections when they are not the label (which the menu and the tab keep): "Hello, {me.name}". {me.name} is the signed-in reader's name, said by the server; with none, the label is drawn. Needs auth. One of `false`. Used in `examples/apps/tick/app.ts`. |

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].by` | string | Stable | What to group by — a bucketed by ("month opened_on") for a line, categories for a donut. "auto created_at" picks the unit (day, week, month or quarter) from the window the reader has picked and how the data falls, and says it under the title. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/pages/resident.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].curve` | `"smooth"` · `"straight"` | Stable | A line's curve: smooth draws a monotone curve through the points. One of `smooth`, `straight`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].empty` |  | Stable | hide leaves the section out of the dashboard while it has nothing to draw. One of `hide`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/pages/maintenance_request.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].format` | `"percent"` · `"number"` · `"money"` · `"duration"` | Stable | How each figure is said where its measure is not one column's, as a metric's: percent (the figure is 0–100, said with %), number, money in the App's currency, or duration (the figure is seconds, said as "10h 2m"). One of `duration`, `money`, `number`, `percent`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/resources.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].height` | number | Stable | The drawing’s height in CSS pixels. Absent means a third of the width, capped. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].kind` |  | Stable |  One of `chart`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].limit` | integer | Stable |  |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].measure` | string | Stable | "count" (default), "sum amount as pipeline". Used in `examples/apps/lintel/dashboards.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].shape` | `"line"` · `"bar"` · `"donut"` · `"stacked"` · `"scatter"` · `"heatmap"` · `"waterfall"` · `"treemap"` | Stable | How it draws. A line wants a bucketed by; bars, a bucketed by or categories, one series with the current bar marked; a donut, categories; stacked, a two-key by — a bar for each group of the first key, divided by the second. Further shapes: scatter (one key, x across and measure up), heatmap (a two-key by as shaded cells), waterfall (one key's rises and falls to a total), treemap (one key's groups as tiles by size). Default line. One of `bar`, `donut`, `heatmap`, `line`, `scatter`, `stacked`, `treemap`, `waterfall`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].target` | number | Stable | A goal drawn as a rule in the ink on a line or stacked chart, and said beside it; not on a donut. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].to` | string | Stable | The list view each group opens, narrowed to the group; false keeps the groups text. Absent, the one list view over the table that the reader is served. One of `false`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/dashboards.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].total` | string | Stable | A donut's words for the figure in its middle, said under it. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].unit` | string | Stable | A word said after each figure ("days", "/mo"). Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=chart].x` | string | Stable | A scatter's across measure ("sum amount"); measure is its up one. Only on a scatter, which needs it. |

Unsaid on a metric with an "over", it is "previous period"; with neither an "over" nor a window in the query, "previous period" is refused. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=metric].format` | `"percent"` · `"number"` · `"money"` · `"duration"` | Stable | metric: how the figure is said where its measure is not one column's: percent (the figure is 0–100, said with %), number, money in the App's currency, or duration (the figure is seconds, said as "10h 2m"). Used in `examples/apps/lintel/dashboards.ts`. |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=metric].spark` | boolean | Stable | Draw the measure’s monthly trend (last 12 months of "over") inside the card while no window stands; a windowed metric draws its trend across the window unless this is false. Composes with the card’s own query — best on cards whose query carries no time clause, and whose clock points backward (an opened_on, not an open deal’s close_date). |
| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=metric].target` | number \| object | Stable | A goal for the measure: the card draws a meter under the number and says the share reached. A number, or a goal read from data in the metric's own words: { table, query, measure }. |

| `views.*[kind=dashboard].sections[][kind=metric].target.query` | string | Stable | The query language, without the leading table name. |

## `views.*[kind=list].sort`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `views.*[kind=list].sort` | string \| array | Stable | The list's order, written like the query bar: "created_on desc" is how it reads when nothing else says one. Two to eight named orders are a Sort menu beside the filters, the first of them the order the list opens in; a chosen one is the query's own sort clause, so the address keeps it. The opening order is kept out of the bar, as order is. A tab's sort clause wins over it, and the menu over both. Not beside order or a sort in query, and not on a board or a calendar. |
